visual_argument: One drawn Gulf Coast neighbourhood goes through every state the tool puts it through, loose drone frames, one stitched map aligned to footprints, every roof judged in a cool ramp, a person's check that turns hollow rims filled, and a gold route out, then frame 1's camera turns home over undamaged Texas ground.
build_risk: Frame 3 must read as many pictures becoming one map in a plan relief, with 2,000 footprint rims, without reading as a waffle chart at feed size, and the relief locks its camera and key to the chassis. Frame 1 must carry 2,000 roofs as a texture gradient behind three big modelled near roofs without becoming a distant dollhouse.
distinct_from_recent: Nov 22 drew cutaway exam rooms, a stethoscope wall and studio benches. Nov 21 drew a tracked rover on rubble in a staged disaster town. Nov 20 drew a survey quad on a ridge. None drew an aerial subdivision with judged roofs, a stitched relief of drone frames, a plate archive, a helmet wall or a route around a fallen oak.
